summary: Iteration 12 — Per-company PIN uniqueness on /api/auth/tenant-set-pin + new PIN-only login endpoint /api/tenant-portal/pin-login + redesigned PIN-only Huurder Kiosk UI. Backend: 15 NEW pytest cases in test_tenant_pin_unique_and_pinlogin.py — all PASS (1 was originally skipped, restructured to use superadmin x-active-company → now PASS). Covers (a) set-pin uniqueness within a company → 409 with the conflicting tenant name in the Dutch detail; (b) same-tenant + same-PIN idempotent → 200; (c) cross-company isolation: a tenant in a DIFFERENT company can re-use PIN 5678 (verified via superadmin x-active-company header against gopi-appartement-s); (d) pin-login via company_slug AND company_id both return 200 + token; (e) wrong PIN → 401, missing context → 400, unknown slug → 400; (f) cross-company no-leak: PIN 5678 against company B does NOT return Bharat (company A); (g) throttle: 8 wrong PINs → 429 lockout; (h) legacy POST /api/tenant-portal/login (identifier+pin) still works. Regression: full run of test_tenant_kiosk.py + test_kiosk_qr_sticker.py — 24 PASS, 1 SKIP (env: no open invoice, pre-existing). Frontend Playwright: /kiosk/huurder?c=surirent shows PIN-only UI (zero tk-email-input, zero 'Doorgaan' button), pinpad visible, footer with 'KEWALBANSING' (app_name) + 'Uit' button, brand-primary CSS var = #ff5c00, wrong PIN triggers red shake + 'Onjuiste PIN' error + auto-clear, correct PIN 5678 → tk-dashboard with balance + 4 tiles, each tile navigates to its view and back. QR mode (?apt=...) shows 'Welkom Bharat' + 'Appartement HUIS 7K' badge, no email input. No-context /kiosk/huurder shows inline error 'Geen bedrijfscontext gevonden — open de Huurder Kiosk via de QR-code.' when PIN submitted.

All-orange palette: tile titles + subtitles are white/orange-tinted on orange background — secondary text ('Geen openstaande facturen', 'Meld een probleem in uw woning', 'Bekijk uw contract & info', 'Bel of WhatsApp ons') has low contrast (visually faint). Consider darker text or a white tile background.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_set_tenant_pin uniqueness loop in server.py (lines 2657-2668): O(N) per-set call iterating ALL tenants of the company with pin_hash to verify_password. For companies with thousands of tenants this could become slow (bcrypt is intentionally slow). Acceptable today (small N), but worth noting for scale.

tenant_portal_pin_login (lines 2691-2729) likewise does an async iteration over all tenants with pin_hash and bcrypt-verifies each. Same scale concern. Mitigations: store an HMAC-of-pin index for fast lookup (then bcrypt-verify only the candidate), or migrate to per-tenant deterministic salt.

company_slug is lowercased before lookup (good). company_id path skips lookup entirely — make sure callers cannot pass an arbitrary company_id to fish for tenants of companies they shouldn't access. Currently the endpoint is PUBLIC, so a leaked company_id allows brute-forcing PINs of that company — mitigated by per-IP+company throttle (8 attempts → 5 min lockout). OK as designed but worth documenting.
TenantPinLoginIn: pin field is min_length=4, max_length=4 — good. Server also re-checks isdigit. Validation layered correctly.

TenantKioskLayout.jsx LoginView prefers prefill.email path even when branding is loaded — correct (QR-mode short-circuits PIN-only). The fallback order (id → slug → throw) is fine; throw message is in Dutch and surfaced via tk-pin-error.
server.py is now ~5360 lines (iter 11 was 5299). Continues to grow. Recommend extracting tenant-portal routes when convenient.
Hard-coded TENANT_TOKEN_KEY in TenantKioskLayout.jsx is consistent with iter 11 — OK.

branding.app_name appears as the prominent welcome heading on kiosk login. For Surirent the seeded app_name is 'KEWALBANSING' (was set by an earlier iteration) — looks confusing on a SuriRent-slug URL. Functional correctness is fine; UX/branding ordering is questionable.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Canonical re-run: `pytest backend/tests/test_tenant_pin_unique_and_pinlogin.py backend/tests/test_tenant_kiosk.py backend/tests/test_kiosk_qr_sticker.py -v`. Throttle is per-IP+company in-memory dict (PIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS=8, PIN_LOCKOUT_SECONDS=300). The TestThrottle class will lock the surirent bucket for 5 min from the test runner's IP — `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` clears it instantly (we did this between the new suite and the regression run). New endpoint: POST /api/tenant-portal/pin-login {pin, company_id|company_slug} → 200 {token,tenant} | 401 wrong PIN | 400 missing context | 429 lockout. set-pin uniqueness uses bcrypt verify_password loop — O(N) per call.
